title: Acyclic Edge Coloring conjecture
statement: Acyclic Edge Coloring conjecture · Fiamčík 1978, sharpened by Alon–Sudakov–Zaks in 2001. Every graph has an acyclic edge coloring with at most Δ+2 colors.

counterexample.description: A connected simple graph of maximum degree five with no proper seven-edge-coloring free of bichromatic cycles. A complete check performs the complete bounded search.
